sections.title: Habit and habitat
sections.text: Cyperus alternifolius is a perennial wetland herb native to Madagascar and the Mascarenes and cultivated as an ornamental. Its upright stems grow about 50–170 cm tall.

sections.title: Bracts and inflorescence
sections.text: At the top of each stem, radiating bracts 20–50 cm long give the inflorescence the appearance of an umbrella about 15–30 cm across. The plate matches this habit and the spikelet detail. Do not confuse it with Cyperus involucratus, sometimes sold under the same horticultural name. No safe food use is established.
